behavior: `Select.Root`, `Combobox.Root` and `Autocomplete.Root` give a form their value with its line breaks, as a `<select>` gives the value of its option with no change. `Select.Root` gives the value in `type="hidden"` inputs, which keep each line break. The input of `Combobox.Root` and `Autocomplete.Root` is a text input, and the value sanitization of HTML removes CR and LF from it. At the `formdata` event of the form, such a part gives its entry the value. `new FormData(form)` and a submission thus have the value of the part. A browser restores only the text of the input. When the text is not the value or the label of an item, `Combobox.Root` selects the item whose value gives that text. This pass comes before the pass of the rendered labels of Base UI. `Combobox.Input` and `Autocomplete.Input` handle a `change` event with no new text as no change. Base UI submits the value without its line breaks, a restore of such a value selects no item, and such a `change` event replaces the value with the text.
